steps.content: [WhiteSands - Reef Sandworm]
A small sand ship stops outside the hideout. On the sand, a line of fresh footprints covers the previous ones.
Inside the hideout, the townsfolk are forced by the security team into a tiny corner. They watch helplessly as the team unearths a large box and places it in front of Scotch.

steps.speaker: Security Team Member
steps.content: Sir, we've found it.
Scotch casually kicks the padlocked Hypercube box. The seemingly heavy box slides over by an inch, scraping loudly against the ground.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: This is too light. They definitely have more. Keep searching.
Scotch turns around, looking at the trembling townsfolk.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Quit acting. There's no way you can protect your town with so little stock.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Any honest lady or gentleman kind enough to share the location of the remaining Hypercubes? Hmm?
No one answers his taunting question.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: No one? What a pity.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Then let's try a more efficient method. That little one over there... Yes him. Take him away.

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: Wha... mmph! Mmm mmmph!
With a point of his finger, Scotch's men drag out Timmy from the back of the crowd. Sharp cries of protest immediately erupt from the crowd.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: What are you doing?! What does this have to do with a child?! Don't touch him!!
A furious Mira is stopped by a team member. He hits her face with the butt of his gun, then pins her firmly to the ground. Scotch walks over to her and leans in, savoring the hate in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Looks like someone is ready to talk. So, where are the remaining Hypercubes?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: ...Get lost! You're not welcome here!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: I locked the box. I hid the Hypercubes. If you want the password and location, come at me! What kind of scum threatens a child?!
Instead of getting angry, Scotch laughs.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Little lady, it's not hard to open the box, but there is only one chance to let you all live. You better think it through.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Hmph...
Mira is pinned to the ground and her lips are cracked from thirst, yet her eyes shine like springs in the night.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Slaying the innocent and treating life with contempt... is this how you do things in DisCity?!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: And you claim to be the last beacon of DisCity? Shame on you!!!
Scotch bursts out laughing, as if having heard an amusing joke.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Beacon? Haha... yes indeed, a beacon, and so much more. It's the "light of civilization," the "torch of humanity," the "center of the world," and the "hub of salvation."
To Scotch, Mira's furious questions are nothing but dinnertime jokes, making him guffaw with laughter.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Everyone should be like you right now, groveling on the ground, serving us.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Do you know why?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Because without DisCity, there would be no Hypercubes. You've only managed to survive till now thanks to those blue little cubes being endlessly shipped out of the city.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Indeed, they're expensive. But so what? Rare things should fetch a high price, shouldn't they?

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Stop twisting the facts!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Half a year ago, it didn't cost this much. You've been using climate change as an excuse to raise the prices! How many have died because they couldn't afford Hypercubes... You don't see us as human!
Scotch slowly crouches down to meet Mira's furious gaze. His voice is as cold as a viper.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Oh, why so pessimistic? These are all <color=#fb9259>necessary</color>.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Rest assured, the money you risked your lives for will be put to good use. They will be invested in some... as they say, <color=#fb9259>greater causes</color>.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: DisCity must be the "torch of human civilization," so the flow of Hypercubes cannot be disrupted. You just need to bow your heads and cough up your money.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: What...
An amused Scotch reaches out and lightly pats Mira's cheek.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: What, dumbfounded? No worries. DisCity doesn't exactly care about human rights or morality either. The social hierarchy there is just like yours.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: We didn't have any grudges initially, but you broke the rules, and I get paid to deal with rule-breakers.
Scotch grabs Mira's hair, forcing her to look up at the townsfolk beside her.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Such a pretty face. What a waste to feed it to the sandworms. Let me think... Oh right, you're so brave and selfless, you must really care about them, right? Do you want to watch them get chewed up by sandworms?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Who should be the first? After I throw them out one by one, someone might "remember" the remaining locations...
Mira tries to resist, but can't stop the security team. Immobilized, she finally breaks down.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Stop!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Stop... I'll tell you...

After getting the locations of the other hideouts, the guards restraining Mira immediately head out to search. Scotch stands up and dusts off the sand from his clothes. As he prepares to leave, he hears Mira's pained voice from behind.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: We've saved up for a long time. Just take it. Please let go... no, I mean, please spare us this once.
Scotch doesn't turn back. He just waves for someone to drag Mira away.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Ha, such a piteous amount... as expected of the Outlanders.
The sobbing girl is dragged away. Since she's already given the information, she is of no value anymore.
And things without value should be discarded.

Scotch walks towards the final target of his mission. There probably aren't that many Hypercubes in the box, but it's better than nothing. It'll be enough for him to report back with. Crouching down, he inputs the code and opens the box...
But he doesn't see the familiar blue glow.
Thick white smoke rapidly pours out of the box, rushing into his nose and mouth. Scotch quickly covers his face and steps back, but the back of his head hits something cold and hard.
The safety pin releases with a crisp click.
What a performance you gave. Now, it's my turn.
As the smoke clears, the gun-toting bounty hunter reveals herself.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Korryn?! You're still alive?!

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Ha, you got lucky. But this ends here... Listen up, everyone! Shoot her!
No one responds. The sobbing Mira had broken free from her restraints and kicked the remaining security forces to the ground.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: Oh dear, who are you ordering around? This one, or that one, or... both of them?
Mira releases her grip, and the unconscious soldiers slump to the ground.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Now it's my turn to say: it's not hard to keep resisting, but you've only got one chance to keep your head. You better think it through, okay?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: ...Ha! You dare attack the security team with just these few stragglers?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Know your place! Our sand ship is docked outside Tuco. A single cannon can flatten your entire town! You'd better be smart and surrender...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Huh? What sand ship? You mean the one that's about to go up in flames?
Korryn's tone is flippant. Scotch suddenly understands the implication behind her words.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: ...Korryn, you conniving b***h...
(Boom! A ship explodes in the distance)
The explosion unleashes a grand fireworks display, illuminating Scotch's plaster-like expression with a kaleidoscope of colors.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Wow! This is much more exciting than fireworks!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: You're right. Normally, even I wouldn't dare cross you big shots... After all, I have many people to protect, and can't afford to mess with you.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So... I found some helping hands. I quietly invited some bold but brainless guests over.
[Enter Memory, WhiteSands - Daytime]

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Run, eh? Dare you to run, pendejo! Pull that crap again and see what happens!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Uh... ahh... huff... huff... Hey buddy, calmed down yet? If we keep delaying, our Hypercubes will end up in someone else's pocket.
The wounded bounty hunter leans casually against the post she's tied to. A young desert bandit, whose ear she shot off, raises his gun warily, but she pays no mind and even flashes him a smile.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: "Our" Hypercubes? Puta madre! If you lot from WhiteSands hadn't stolen our friggin' goods, how would we have lost it?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: That's not the right way to look at things. Without Tuco as a sitting duck, the security bigwigs will target you desert bandits next.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: They control the Hypercube economy and inflate the prices, so we have no choice but to steal and rob... You and I have never been enemies. The real enemies are the DisCity folks controlling the Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: ...Cut the crap. What you gonna do?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: No no no boss! We can't trust this woman! We've been screwed over several times already!
The young desert bandit's gun is knocked away in annoyance by his leader. Korryn suppresses a smirk, then dishes out her bait.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No matter how much we rob, there's a limit to the amount of Hypercubes controlled by the desert bandits and Tuco... Why don't we team up and go big?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: You're going after the security team's sand ship?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: That's right. Tuco will help divert their firepower. Not only will you get Hypercubes, but also their heavy weaponry. Their gear is way better than your knock-offs.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: So we get the Hypercubes, as well as the gear? You sure make it sound sweet, Korryn. You think I'd believe that you won't take a single cut?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Because you have no choice but to believe.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: DisCity has opened a new mine. They need to establish authority and clear threats along the trade routes, so they'll invest more on military upgrades. The WhiteSands security team is just the beginning. Soon, our firepower will fall behind DisCity.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: If you don't dare to rob now, there'll be no chance to rise up later.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The world is changing. Those who don't struggle will eventually be devoured by WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: That includes us both.
(Boom... The sound of the security team's sand ship exploding in the distance)

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Holy cow, boss! That bounty hunter didn't trick us this time! The security team is really dumb enough not to guard their ship?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Cut the crap! Hold your gun right! Hit those security bastards hard while we can!
The desert bandit ships rise from the sands, speeding towards the smoking security ship. Sandstorms swirl in the air. Korryn cups her hands over her eyes, gazing towards the blazing site.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Wow. They move pretty fast.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Aren't you going after them? If you don't, your ship and Hypercubes are all gonna be gone!
To show her "friendliness," she even withdraws her gun. But Scotch's face has already turned dark.
At this moment, several team members who went to investigate the other Hypercube hideouts rush back.

steps.speaker: Security Team Member
steps.content: Sir, there's nothing at the location that woman told us...

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Shut up, you useless fool!
No longer able to maintain his composure, Scotch slaps his subordinate in anger. After a brief assessment of the situation, he strides quickly towards the little speedboat.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Start the speedboat! Prioritize breaking up those desert bandits!

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: No matter what, get our ship back first!
The security team hurriedly starts the speedboat and speeds away. Korryn lowers her hat brim, covering the gleam in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: The show is just starting. Let's have some fun.
